name: Regularised Marching Tetrahedra
definition: An iso-surface extraction algorithm that combines Marching Tetrahedra for topological consistency and Vertex Clustering for mesh simplification, generating surfaces with improved triangle aspect ratios and reduced triangle count.
summary: Regularised Marching Tetrahedra is an iso-surface extraction algorithm that combines Marching Tetrahedra with vertex clustering to produce topologically consistent meshes with significantly fewer, near-regular triangles for improved shading.
